title: Never Walk Away From Your REFLECTION 🪞
description:
In this town, never walk away from your reflection. It stays in the glass and waits. The fry cart's shiny side holds a line a hundred people long, and a puddle on the boards still has a man tying his boot from March.

It's the last night of the traveling fair, and my best friend Tasha meets me at the mirror maze, the way she has every night this week.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment PICKLE for the friend who always pays.
old_title: In This Town Mirrors KEEP Your Reflection
